thread:
maria.g: Quick pulse — doing the egress validation for customer 'Helix' staging VPC. Gate 2 (comms) is flapping during our TCP probe. Anyone on routing/egress can confirm if the new route table + NAT change landed?

alex.p: On it. I deployed the route change 30m ago (CR-7721). I see the route in the console but the ASG health check shows ~20% connection resets to 10.0.48.0/24. Will check NAT logs.

jin.k: Re: CR-7721 — I reviewed the terraform plan, the change touched the public subnet nat association. @alex.p did you also update the egress security policy on the firewall appliance (per customer's airgap checklist)?

alex.p: I did NOT touch the firewall appliance. That was supposed to be ops handoff. @sam_t do you own the appliance change?

sam_t: Yep I own the firewall change. I pushed a staged rule but held before committing because we needed the customer's approval window. I can commit now if you give thumbs. :thumbsup:

maria.g: Customer gave verbal OK in yesterday's call but legal asked us to gate the commit until they sign the amendment — trying to avoid surprise. If we commit before the amendment, we need a rollback plan.

lisa-r: Ops notes — committing the firewall rule requires a rolling update with window 02:00-03:00 UTC. If we do it now, we'll trigger support paging for oncall. Suggest we do a targeted temp allow from 52.14.0.0/16 -> staging nat for the smoke instead of wide-open change.

net-sre-bot: probe-result: tcp:10.0.48.22:443 CONNECT fail (RST) at 2391122400; tcp:10.0.48.22:443 CONNECT ok at 2391122600

alex.p: NAT logs show SNAT translations failing intermittently — pattern looks like connection tracking table exhaustion when bursting 2000 concurrent probes. We can lower probe rate, but real traffic will produce same pattern unless we adjust conntrack/tcp-timeout or add a second NAT.

maria.g: Action items: (1) sam_t to confirm firewall temp allow or customer sign-off, (2) alex.p to open infra ticket for conntrack tuning + add second NAT as a mitigant (ticket INF-1445), (3) jin.k to validate terraform keeps change idempotent with the staged rule.

sam_t: I'll message the customer PM now to nudge the amendment. If they can't sign within the next 2 hours, I propose the targeted temp allow and we record the window + mitigations in the change. Will update here.

alex.p: Created INF-1445 + linked CR-7721 -> INF-1445. Notes: plan to add a hot NAT (expected ~10m) then tune /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max to 1.2M. scoped to staging only.

maria.g: @ops-bot can you schedule a short oncall page if firewall commit goes outside 02:00-03:00 UTC? We'll prefer the window but want safety.

ops-bot: paging-schedule created: page if firewall-commit outside window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Escalation: oncall -> infra-lead.

jin.k: Quick code-review ping: PR #1421 updates the terraform resource for the firewall rule. I left one comment about the lifecycle ignore_changes to avoid drift on provider-managed fields. @alex.p can you take a look?

alex.p: Reviewing PR #1421 now. If we go with temp allow, I'll add a conditional flag so we can flip it without a full apply.

maria.g: Thanks team. Please add short status updates here — we need a single source for the customer's readiness board. I'll update the preflight doc once we confirm firewall window or temp allow.

sam_t: Customer PM responded: "we can sign in 3-4h, prefer targeted temp allow now" — going to commit temp rule in 10m and monitor. I'll paste the exact rule here after commit.

sam_t: committed rule -> `allow tcp 52.14.0.0/16 10.0.48.0/24 443` applied to fw-staging-appliance-3 (audit: CHG-7721-temp). Rolling change started 2391122880.

net-sre-bot: probe-result: tcp:10.0.48.22:443 CONNECT ok at 2391122935

maria.g: Nice. alex.p please proceed with INF-1445 planning so we don't need temp rules next week. jin.k please mark PR #1421 as needs-rebase after alex updates conditional flag. I'll close the loop on customer legal sign-off when I have it.

alex.p: Will validate NAT scale-out steps in INF-1445 and post ETA. Expected mitigation deploy in staging by EOD.

maria.g: Excellent. Thanks all — keeping this thread as the canonical trace for the staging egress validation. :white_check_mark:
